lines.en: I follow the roots inward.
My head hangs nearly to the ground.
I push through the fronds.

lines.zh: 我贴着树根走，头几乎擦地。
lines.en: I keep to the roots, head almost scraping ground.
I creep along in the tree shade.
My heels touch down first.
I follow the game trail.
I snap dry branches underfoot.
I glance up at the canopy.
I cross a patch of moss sideways.
I pause behind a trunk.
I go on close to the ground.
I squeeze between two trunks.
I move slowly deeper in.
I lie under the roots.

lines.zh: 我把厚实的头搁在地上
lines.en: I rest my heavy head on the ground.
I listen without moving.
My tail curls round my hind legs.
I open and close my jaws slowly.
I wait for something to stir.

lines.zh: 鼻孔动了动，闻出你的位置。
lines.en: Nostrils twitch, and I have your position.
I stretch my neck a little.
I raise my head to the wind.
This face of mine is wrinkled.
I close my eyes again.
I rest in the shade.
I roll my neck slowly.
I make no movement at all.
I show my head from behind the trunk.
I pin you with one eye.
I smell smoke and fire on you.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，声音在树间回
lines.en: I growl, and it echoes off the trees.

lines.zh: 你把这片林子当什么地方了
lines.en: What do you take this wood for?
My eyes lock on your ankle.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低到蕨丛下
lines.en: I sink below the ferns.
I tilt that heavy head.
Your smell is too new for this place.
I keep my jaws open and wait.

lines.zh: 森林里的肉食者，脸很皱。
lines.en: A wrinkled face on a forest hunter.
Let us see whether you step back.
I stumble sideways.
I growl and pull back behind a tree.
The hide on my flank splits.
I swing my heavy head.
I snap two dry branches.
I settle my weight low again.
I gape and drag in air.
My short snout has gone numb.
My short snout wrinkles once.
I do not mean to leave yet.
You dangle it in your hand.
I stretch my neck to sniff.
I have never eaten that.
The smell is off.
One bite and I spit it out.
I run my tongue over my teeth.
I turn my head to your hand.
That is not a meal.
I turn my head away.
I go on into the wood.
You crash into me and my legs hold.
One roll of my shoulder pushes you back.
We collide against the roots.
Twigs snap under my feet.
I look down where you hit.
I feel no pain at all.
I turn and yield half the path.
That force is far from enough.
I step back into the shade.
You knocked the fern fronds off me.
Another paces out of the ferns.
Our snouts touch.
It stands half a head shorter.
We follow the game trail together.
It butts me with that heavy head.

lines.zh: 我们停在两棵老树之间
lines.en: We stop between two old trunks.
It rumbles and I answer.
We fall silent again.
It goes deeper first.
I follow at its rear flank.
I dip my head and take a piece.
I shake it over to the roots.
One snap and it is swallowed.
I spit it out to look.
I press it into the moss.
I push it away with my snout.
I sniff and lose interest.
I carry it behind a tree.
I drop it and move on.
I carry the carrion back into the ferns.
My head halts in midair.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧对那个方向
lines.en: I turn my flank that way.
My claws dig into the leaf litter.
I give one short bark.

lines.zh: 树影里那个人形我看见了
lines.en: I have seen the shape in the shade.
It cannot run from this distance.
I sink my weight.
I have the angle for the charge.
I drop my head below my shoulders.
I do not mean to hesitate.
I give one short bark first.
I reach a foreleg forward.
My tail goes taut.
I am ready to charge.
I stalk it with heavy steps.
It ducks behind a trunk; I go round.

lines.zh: 我把你往空地赶，森林的藤太密。
lines.en: I herd you to open ground; forest vines are thick.
I growl and come on.
Each step you give, I take.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚绊到树根
lines.en: I wait for your foot to catch a root.
The leaf litter is too deep for speed.
I drop my head nearly to my knees.
Your hand has moved.

lines.zh: 我从右边的树缝切过去
lines.en: I cut through the gap on the right.
I hear you panting.
Two strides reach you.
I pause, then press on.
You are backed against an old tree.
I mean to hit you with my head.
I send my shoulder forward.
It will likely move first.
I drive my low head in.
I clamp its shoulder.
I sweep its legs out.
It lands in the leaf litter.
I set a foot on its back.
I shake my head and tear it open.
It rolls and breaks free.
I butt again from the right.
I slam it into a trunk.
It bites my forelimb.
I wrench it loose.
The leaves scatter.
It backs off; I stand panting.
I lower my head and wait.
It gets its legs under it.
I open my jaws again.

lines.zh: 林子太密，我撞断了几枝。
lines.en: The grove is thick; I snapped a few branches.

lines.zh: 我的脚陷进松软的腐叶
lines.en: My feet sink into soft litter.
I sniff this old tree first.
I stop between two trunks.
My tail sweeps the moss.
A new shadow in the ferns.
I raise my head to the canopy.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出一声短吼
lines.en: A short bark rolls out.
I have found this game trail.
I begin patrolling the wood's edge.
The leaf litter is deep here.
I swing half round.
My shadow falls over the roots.
I go deeper with my head low.
I snap a dry branch underfoot.
I will keep watch here.
Fire runs along my back.
I slide down the slope into the brush.
Water covers my snout.

lines.zh: 木头碎片扎进我的侧腹。
lines.en: Wood splinters dug into my flank.

lines.zh: 皱脸的头骨，十四点一口。
lines.en: A wrinkled skull, fourteen per bite.
Spell light makes me shake my head.
Hunger weakens my legs.

lines.zh: 雷劈开了我旁边那棵树
lines.en: Lightning splits the tree beside me.
The whole forest floor is gone.
